description:
Tails and ships log files

Filebeat is an open source file harvester, mostly used to fetch logs files and feed them into logstash. Together with the libbeat lumberjack output is a replacement for logstash-forwarder.
Features and enhancements
All
- Update Go to 1.26.10. #53706
Filebeat
- Ensure that the CEL input's events from previous evaluations are removed from the CEL state before starting a new evaluation. #53817
- Add proxy_url and proxy_disable support to the azure-eventhub input, reject WebSocket transport with processor v1, and propagate checkpoint migration errors. #53534
Metricbeat
- Collect the serverless.search.min_search_vcu cluster setting as a number in the autoops_es module's cluster_settings metricset. #53943
- Add os.cgroup.cpu.usage_percent to the autoops_es module's node_stats metricset. #53140 #52616
- Add the frozen_cache_stats metricset to the autoops_es module to collect node-level searchable snapshot shared cache statistics. #53067
Packetbeat
- Bundle the Npcap OEM installer with Packetbeat for Windows on ARM64. #53658
- Update the Npcap OEM installer to 1.88. #53773
- Update the Npcap OEM installer to 1.89. #53706
Fixes
All
- Fix a data race in the translate_ldap_attribute processor. #51690
- Only log the metrics namespaces listed in logging.metrics.namespaces (default [stats]). Per-input metrics (monitoring.dataset.*) are no longer logged by default. #53919
- Fix a deadlock in the OTel registry bridge when new metrics appear during collection. #53995 #53991
Auditbeat
- Fix the file_integrity eBPF backend failing to start on Linux 6.15 and later. #53511 #46719
- Fix a panic in the file_integrity eBPF backend when its eBPF loader fails to start. #53785
- Fix the file_integrity kprobes backend hanging at startup when probe verification keeps failing. #53782
Elastic Agent
- Fix unbounded memory growth when the Logstash exporter admits batches out of order under the OTel runtime. #54036
Filebeat
- Update github.com/apache/thrift to v0.25.0 to fix CVE-2026-82458 in Parquet decoding. #53636
- Fix cursor inputs losing their saved position when two inputs start at the same time. #53204
- Resume CrowdStrike Event Streams after dropped firehose connections without exhausting retries. #53416
- Validate the http_endpoint input's configuration for HTTP OPTIONS requests at startup. When options_headers is set, it must not be empty, and options_response_code must be valid. A previously accepted empty options_headers: {} now fails at startup. #53417
- Fix a goroutine spinning at 100% CPU after a log input harvester is closed. #53777
- Fix the azure-eventhub v1 input crashing the OTel Collector with a concurrent map iteration and map write. #53822 #53816
- Fix TCP and UDP input receive queue and packet drop metrics always reporting 0 when listening on 0.0.0.0 on hosts with IPv6 enabled. #53972
- Fix the scratch_dir option being ignored by the Okta entity analytics provider when use_minimal_state is enabled. #53979
- Fix the system module's auth fileset ingest pipeline failing on journald events without journald.process.name. #54033 #54013
- Reduce the memory retained by the azure-eventhub v2 input while waiting for acknowledgments. #54014
Heartbeat
- Bump npm to 12.2.1 and Node.js to 22.23.4 (24.22.1 on Wolfi) in the Heartbeat Docker images to remove vulnerable undici copies. #53947
- Fix malformed Synthetics runner log messages. #53593
- Fix Heartbeat memory growth by releasing popped tasks from the scheduler timer queue. #53664 #53662
Metricbeat
- Skip unsupported Azure Monitor metric namespaces when ignore_unsupported is true instead of failing collection on HTTP 400. #53643 #52999
- Collect running snapshot tasks in the autoops_es module's tasks_management metricset by filtering on cluster:admin/snapshot instead of the nonexistent indices:admin/snapshot actions. #54100
Osquerybeat
- Restore osquery-extension compatibility with Linux systems that use glibc versions earlier than 2.28. #52651
- Fix Osquerybeat sending action responses to the wrong data stream under the OTel runtime. #53322 #15964
- Honor Osquery RPC cancellation without breaking later result resolution. #53774 #53645
- Restart osqueryd when it exits with code 78 after startup. Exit code 78 during startup is still treated as a failure. #53776 #53645
Packetbeat
- Fix per-stream interface and procs settings being dropped under the OTel runtime. #53301
- Fix the SIP parser populating the contact fields from the To header instead of the Contact header. #53418
- Fix a nil map panic and missed completion for zero-body messages in the AMQP parser. #53491
- Fix pgsql queries being paired with the wrong responses after a NULL column. #53666
- Reject invalid negative RESP array lengths in the Redis parser. #53843
- Fix length and count decoding in the Packetbeat Cassandra parser. #54067
